message.Title: Public Preview: Durable Task SDK for Go

Body.Markdown:
The Durable Task SDK

for Go is available in public preview. Developers can write orchestrations,

activities, and durable entities in Go, with Durable Task Scheduler managing

execution history and work dispatch.

Customers can build workflows with retries, timers, external events, and

parallel processing while running workers on their own compute.

Learn more .
